basic.name: Farewell Hit
basic.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{damage}}% of The Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.name: RIP Home Run
skill.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{skill_damage}}% of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy and enemies adjacent to it.

ultimate.name: Stardust Ace
ultimate.description_template: Choose between two attack modes to deliver a full strike.

variants.name: Blowout: Farewell Hit
variants.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{ult_st}}% of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.

variants.name: Blowout: RIP Home Run
variants.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{ult_blast_main}}% of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy, and Physical DMG equal to {{ult_blast_adj}}% of the Trailblazer's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.

talent.name: Perfect Pickoff
talent.description_template: Each time after this character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, ATK increases by {{atk_buff}}%. This effect stacks up to 2 time(s).

technique.name: Immortal Third Strike
technique.description: Immediately heals all allies for 15% of their respective Max HP after using this Technique.

2.name: Ready for Battle
2.description: At the start of battle, immediately regenerates 15 energy.

4.name: Tenacity
4.description: Each Talent stack increases the Trailblazer's DEF by 10%.

6.name: Fighting Will
6.description: When using Skill or Ultimate "Blowout: RIP Home Run", DMG dealt to the target enemy is increased by 25%

eidolons.name: A Falling Star
eidolons.description: When enemies are defeated due to the Trailblazer's Ultimate, the Trailblazer regenerates 10 extra Energy. This effect can only be triggered once per attack.

eidolons.name: An Unwilling Host
eidolons.description: Attacking enemies with Physical Weakness restores the Trailblazer's HP equal to 5% of the Trailblazer's ATK.

eidolons.name: A Leading Whisper
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: A Destructing Glance
eidolons.description: When attacking an enemy that is Weakness Broken, increases CRIT Rate by 25%.

eidolons.name: A Surviving Hope
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: A Trailblazing Will
eidolons.description: The Trailblazer's Talent is also triggered when they defeat an enemy.
